name: Hidakagawa (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Hidakagawa town emblem in light blue and green: a light blue disc of curved lines with a green stylised letter W.
history: Municipal flag of Hidakagawa, a town in Wakayama Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 May 2005.

features.role: Hidakagawa town emblem — a light blue disc of curved lines with a green stylised letter W
